description: This Java source file defines the class ModifyFeaturePropertiesStrategy, a strategy for handling ModifyFeatureProperties commands within the Eclipse Ditto platform. It manages the modification or creation of feature properties for a Thing entity in a persistence context, including size validation, event generation, and handling of associated headers and metadata.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturePropertiesStrategy
classes.description: A final class implementing a command handling strategy for modifying or creating feature properties on a Thing. It extends AbstractThingCommandStrategy specialized for ModifyFeatureProperties commands.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Main method executing the command logic: validates size, extracts feature, and returns appropriate result (modify or create).

methods.name: extractFeature
methods.description: Retrieves the specific feature from the Thing based on the feature ID in the command.

methods.name: getModifyOrCreateResult
methods.description: Determines whether to modify existing feature properties or create new ones, returning the corresponding result.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Builds a result indicating feature property modification, generating the appropriate event and response.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Builds a result indicating creation of feature properties, generating the corresponding event and response.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the entity tag prior to modification for concurrency control.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Determines the next entity tag after modification for concurrency control.
